title: Sharplink header
description: A fixed, transparent bar: a wordmark on the left and, on the right, a row of separate square glass boxes (narrow uppercase links, 2px apart) ending in a square arrow box. Its colours flip between light and dark to match the section scrolling beneath it; on phones a MENU box and a hamburger box open a full-screen dark menu.
notes: sections mark themselves with data-sharplink-tone="dark" (or "light" inside a dark one) so the bar switches to the theme's dark colours over them
needs JavaScript for the tone switch and the phone menu (hydrate: load)
name: sharplink-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, shown as the wordmark

props.name: brandMark
props.description: a small mark before the name (an icon or svg)

props.name: action
props.description: the square arrow box at the end of the row (e.g. to the main dashboard)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: the label of the phone menu button

props.name: initialTone
props.description: colours before the page has been measured: dark when the first section is dark
